blocks.text: The Senate resumes the impeachment proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday, September 29, as senators continue deliberations in the historic trial. Follow CDN Digital’s live coverage below for the latest developments, key exchanges, and updates from the Senate as the proceedings unfold. Impeachment Trial: Baste Duterte testifies before Senate Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte took the witness stand on Tuesday in the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. The House prosecution panel presented Baste Duterte to testify on the Davao City government’s transactions with GenCorp Industries Inc., a company allegedly linked to the vice president’s business interests.
